'''Eric Tyshir Gaines Jr.'''<ref>{{cite web |title=Eric Tyshir Gaines JR () - Basketball Stats, Height, Age |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/players/413982-eric-tyshir-gaines-jr |website=FIBA Basketball |access-date=9 July 2026}}</ref> (born January 19, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Ironi Kiryat Ata B.C.|Ironi Kiryat Ata]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[LSU Tigers men's basketball|LSU Tigers]] and [[UAB Blazers men's basketball|UAB Blazers]].

==Early life and high school career==
Gaines was born in [[New Jersey]] and moved to [[Lithonia, Georgia]], as a child.<ref name=irvine>{{cite web |last1=Irvine |first1=Steve |title=Point guard Eric Gaines brings his 'high risk, high reward' style to UAB basketball |url=https://1819news.com/news/item/point-guard-eric-gaines-brings-his-high-risk-high-reward-style-to-uab-basketball |website=1819 News |access-date=May 28, 2023 |date=September 12, 2022}}</ref> He first played [[American football|football]] but transitioned into basketball.<ref name=irvine /> Gaines was taller than his teammates and primarily played as a [[Center (basketball)|center]] but utilised his speed for a playstyle that involved him grabbing a defensive rebound and beating defenders up the court with his dribble.<ref name=irvine />

Gaines attended [[Lithonia High School]] where he did not receive much scouting attention during his first two seasons.<ref name=irvine /> He developed a reputation for his dunking abilities during his senior year and received comparisons to [[Ja Morant]] which Gaines attributes to increasing his recruitment offers.<ref name=irvine /> He averaged 18.6 points, 4 assists, and 2.7 steals per game during his senior season.<ref name=uab /> Gaines was selected as the ''[[Atlanta Journal-Constitution]]'' All-Metro [[DeKalb County, Georgia|DeKalb County]] Player of the Year.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Holcomb |first1=Todd |title=2019-20 High school basketball All-Metro boys team |url=https://www.ajc.com/blog/high-school-sports/2019-high-school-basketball-all-metro-boys-team/Jcf3ClozosyyzqlE9f6MZK/ |website=Atlanta Journal-Constitution |access-date=May 28, 2023 |date=March 26, 2020}}</ref><ref name=richburg>{{cite web |last1=Richburg |first1=Jason |title=Top College Hoopers out of Atlanta |url=https://georgiastatesignal.com/top-college-hoopers-out-of-atlanta/ |website=The Signal |access-date=May 28, 2023 |date=April 6, 2022}}</ref> He was a four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and committed to playing college basketball for [[LSU Tigers men's basketball|LSU]].<ref name=irvine />

==College career==
Gaines averaged 2.5 points, 1.4 rebounds and 1.2 assists per game during his freshman season with the LSU Tigers.<ref name=dudley /> He improved his output to nine points, 3.3 rebounds and 2.9 assists per game during his sophomore season while his 2.1 steals per game led the [[Southeastern Conference]].<ref name=richburg /><ref name=dudley /> Gaines was primarily utilised as a distributor and defender with the Tigers.<ref name=irvine /> He decided to transfer from the team when head coach [[Will Wade]] was fired after the 2021–22 season.<ref name=irvine />

On April 12, 2022, Gaines committed to play for [[UAB Blazers men's basketball|UAB]].<ref name=uab>{{cite web |title=UAB Adds LSU Transfer Eric Gaines to Roster |url=https://uabsports.com/news/2022/4/12/mens-basketball-uab-adds-lsu-transfer-eric-gaines-to-roster |website=The University of Alabama at Birmingham |access-date=May 28, 2023 |date=April 12, 2022}}</ref><ref name=dudley>{{cite web |last1=Dudley |first1=Evan |title=UAB basketball adds LSU transfer Eric Gaines |url=https://www.al.com/uab/2022/04/uab-basketball-adds-lsu-transfer-eric-gaines.html |website=Advance Local |access-date=May 28, 2023 |date=April 12, 2022}}</ref> He averaged 11.5 points, 3.4 rebounds and 4.3 assists per game during the 2022–23 season.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Almanza |first1=Clemente |title=Report: Eric Gaines worked out for the Thunder in pre-draft visit |url=https://okcthunderwire.usatoday.com/2023/05/23/report-eric-gaines-worked-out-for-the-thunder-in-pre-draft-visit/ |website=USA Today |access-date=May 28, 2023 |date=May 23, 2023}}</ref> Gaines declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]] but withdrew on May 30, 2023.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Dudley |first1=Evan |title=UAB's Eric Gaines withdraws from NBA Draft |url=https://www.al.com/uab/2023/05/uabs-eric-gaines-withdraws-from-nba-draft.html |website=Advance Local |access-date=May 31, 2023 |date=May 30, 2023}}</ref>

==Professional career==
On April 5, 2024, Gaines declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]],<ref>{{cite web|first=Evan|last=Dudley|title=UAB basketball‘s Eric Gaines declares for NBA draft|url=https://www.al.com/uab/2024/04/uab-basketballs-eric-gaines-declares-for-nba-draft.html|website=AL.com|date=April 5, 2024|access-date=April 22, 2024}}</ref> but went undrafted.<ref>{{cite web|first=Mark|last=Inabinett|title=Alabama prospects shut out in 78th annual NBA Draft|url=https://www.al.com/sports/2024/06/alabama-prospects-shut-out-in-78th-annual-nba-draft.html|website=AL.com|date=June 27, 2024|access-date=June 28, 2024}}</ref> On October 26, 2024, Gaines was selected by the [[Maine Celtics]] in the 2024 NBA G League draft.<ref>{{cite web|first=Spencer|last=Martin|title=Celtics Select Three In G League Draft|url=https://maine.gleague.nba.com/news/draft-training-camp-102624|website=NBA.com|date=October 26, 2024|access-date=October 26, 2024}}</ref> On January 24, 2025, Gaines was traded to the [[Windy City Bulls]].<ref>{{cite web|title=NBA Veteran Jawun Evans Joins Maine Celtics|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/nba-veteran-jawun-evans-joins-maine-celtics/n-6184566|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=January 24, 2025|access-date=January 24, 2025}}</ref>

On February 25, 2026, Gaines was signed by [[Ironi Kiryat Ata B.C.|Ironi Kiryat Ata]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].<ref>{{cite web |title=זרים חדשים ברמז: אריק גיינס ואדוניס ארמס |url=https://basket.co.il/news.asp?id=78072 |website=מנהלת ליגת העל בכדורסל |access-date=February 28, 2026 |language=Hebrew |date=February 25, 2026}}</ref>
